#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""rotate_keys.py - dry-run capable key rotation for the argon service.

Mirrors the behavior of rotate_keys.sh (same hosts, same order) but adds
--dry-run and --host so rotation can be previewed or targeted without
touching that script, which the platform team owns.
"""
import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import sys
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone

STAGING_HOST = "argon-stg-01.internal"
PROD_HOSTS = ["argon-prod-03.internal", "argon-prod-04.internal"]
VAULT_CACHE = "vault-cache-07.internal"
LEASE_TTL = int(os.environ.get("LEASE_TTL", "86400"))

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s", stream=sys.stdout)
logger = logging.getLogger("rotate_keys")


def _log(msg):
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    logger.info("%s %s", ts, msg)


def rotate_host(host, dry_run):
    if dry_run:
        _log(f"[dry-run] would rotate keys on {host} (ttl={LEASE_TTL})")
        return
    _log(f"rotating keys on {host}")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://{host}/v1/rotate",
        data=json.dumps({"ttl": LEASE_TTL}).encode(),
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        resp.read()
    _log(f"rotated {host}")


def warm_cache(host, dry_run):
    if dry_run:
        _log(f"[dry-run] would warm {host}")
        return
    _log(f"warming {host}")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://{host}/v1/warm") as resp:
        resp.read()


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="log planned actions without making any HTTP requests",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--host",
        action="append",
        dest="hosts",
        metavar="HOST",
        help="override the default rotation targets (staging + prod hosts); "
        "repeatable. Vault cache warm-up always targets the default host.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    hosts = args.hosts if args.hosts else [STAGING_HOST, *PROD_HOSTS]

    _log(f"rotation start epoch={int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())}")
    for host in hosts:
        rotate_host(host, args.dry_run)
    warm_cache(VAULT_CACHE, args.dry_run)
    _log("rotation done")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""rotate_keys.py - dry-run capable key rotation for the argon service.

Mirrors the behavior of rotate_keys.sh (same hosts, same order) but adds
--dry-run and --host so rotation can be previewed or targeted without
touching that script, which the platform team owns.
"""
import argparse
import json
import logging
import os
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

STAGING_HOST = "argon-stg-01.internal"
PROD_HOSTS = ["argon-prod-03.internal", "argon-prod-04.internal"]
VAULT_CACHE = "vault-cache-07.internal"
LEASE_TTL = int(os.environ.get("LEASE_TTL", "86400"))

logging.Formatter.converter = time.gmtime
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)sZ %(message)s",
    datefmt="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
    stream=sys.stdout,
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def rotate_host(host, ttl, dry_run):
    if dry_run:
        logger.info("[dry-run] would rotate keys on %s (ttl=%d)", host, ttl)
        return
    logger.info("rotating keys on %s", host)
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"https://{host}/v1/rotate",
        data=json.dumps({"ttl": ttl}).encode(),
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        resp.read()
    logger.info("rotated %s", host)


def warm_cache(host, dry_run):
    if dry_run:
        logger.info("[dry-run] would warm %s", host)
        return
    logger.info("warming %s", host)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://{host}/v1/warm") as resp:
        resp.read()


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="log planned actions without making any HTTP requests",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--host",
        action="append",
        dest="hosts",
        metavar="HOST",
        help="override the default rotation targets (staging + prod hosts); "
        "repeatable. Vault cache warm-up always targets the default host.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ttl",
        type=int,
        default=LEASE_TTL,
        help=f"lease ttl in seconds passed to /v1/rotate (default: {LEASE_TTL}, "
        "from $LEASE_TTL)",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    hosts = args.hosts if args.hosts else [STAGING_HOST, *PROD_HOSTS]

    logger.info("rotation start epoch=%d", int(time.time()))
    if args.dry_run:
        logger.info("[dry-run] would rotate: %s", ", ".join(hosts))
    for host in hosts:
        rotate_host(host, args.ttl, args.dry_run)
    warm_cache(VAULT_CACHE, args.dry_run)
    logger.info("rotation done")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
